Check scope and execution records

Topology has no per-rule completion records. An empty message list does not mean that every check completed. Read the scope and limitations below.

Check scope and limitations

Counts include only known external connections without uncertain conditions. The inventory also keeps unknown connections. A blank endpoint means that external rules do not describe it. The tool does not reconstruct internal networks or runtime-created Nodes.

Node balance, supply, and NSD checks are in the Node report. Topology also reports retrofit capacity associations. ERROR/WARNING groups follow shared repair tasks. Display categories can collect several related groups. Original group and message counts do not change.
